paragraphs.text: In this the Prophet represents the person of God, who loved his Church before he called her, and did not withdraw his love when she gave herself to idols.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, gave themselves wholly to pleasure, and could not stop, as those that are given to drunkenness.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Yet I loved her and paid a small portion for her, lest she would have perceived the greatness of my love, and abused me, and not been under duty: for fifteen pieces of silver was but half the price of a slave; Ex 21:32.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: I bought her to me for

paragraphs.text: I will try you a long time as in your widowhood, whether you will be mine or not.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Meaning not only all the time of their captivity, but also until Christ.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: abide many days without a king

paragraphs.text: That is, they would neither have administration nor religion, and their idols also in which they put their confidence, would be destroyed.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: This is meant of Christ's kingdom, which was promised to David to be eternal; Ps 72:17.
paragraphs.label: g
